root_cause.summary: Daily social reconciliation could retroactively mark an already provider-created LinkedIn or Instagram publication as BLOCKED when later readback, token or media-proof checks failed.
causes: post-create verification state was allowed to overwrite provider-write truth
read/admin/token/media-proof capabilities were conflated with existence of an already-created provider side effect
watchdogs could reopen a completed publication obligation instead of treating its durable external ID as an anti-duplicate fence

prevention_rules: A successful provider create/publish response plus durable external ID is terminal side-effect evidence.
Persist the external ID immediately and set republish_forbidden=true.
Never downgrade an already provider-created social post solely because later readback, token, ACL or media-proof checks fail.
Post-create verification failures become enrichment/reconciliation state, not publication failure.
Future auth or media-quality repairs apply prospectively to the next claim and may not create a replacement for the current claim.
Watchdogs reconcile exact provider IDs and cannot reopen provider-created obligations into duplicate-capable states.

outcome.intended_state: Every daily social provider-created side effect remains terminally published for anti-duplicate purposes while later verification failures are handled without replacement publication.
